fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) plunged 7.3% on Friday after Rothschild & Co Redburn analyst Mike Harrison downgraded from neutral (buy) and cut target price from $595 to $398.
fields.summary_ko.1: Harrison cited increasing customer concentration and dependence on AI startups like OpenAI and Anthropic as a concern, with Broadcom providing financing guarantees of up to $6.3 billion to Anthropic and $5 billion to OpenAI.
